items.summary: Moody's (MCO) is pushing further into digital assets after completing a pilot with Chainlink that sent sample credit ratings across multiple blockchains using Chainlink's interoperability protocol and Moody's Token Integration Engine. Over the past month, Moody's has seen a 10.0% 30 day share price return and a 6.9% 90 day share price return. items.summary: Moody's has ridden a strong multi year share price upswing, and that kind of climb naturally raises the question of whether the business is earning enough on its capital to support a valuation at this level. items.title: Moody’s Pilot With Chainlink Puts Test Ratings on Several Blockchains in One Pass
items.summary: Moody's has so far added its ratings engine one blockchain at a time. This time the companies sent the same stand-in ratings to several chains at once, a trial with no real rating actions that ran only on test networks.

items.title: Moody’s and S&P downgrade Akamai on debt-fueled AI infrastructure buildout
items.summary: Investing.com -- Akamai Technologies Inc (NASDAQ:AKAM) saw its credit profile take a significant hit on Monday as both Moody’s Ratings and S&P Global Ratings downgraded the company following its decision to raise over $2 billion in convertible debt to pre-fund an aggressive push into artificial intelligence edge infrastructure.
